title: Report chart: split a series by a second dataset dimension
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27430 (rows 2–4) said: TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `ed0e71db` (report 6515939841, `out_of_scope_findings`). Row 2 is taken in PR #27972.
Reach: any report that wants a bar per X split by Y. HotCRM `opportunity_funnel_owner_stage` (a bar per owner, split by stage); hotcrm#2379 turned it into an owner × stage `matrix` as the workaround (#27430 row 4).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the key; `Metadata-protocol` added), then `domain:ui` (`plugin-report`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "report chart series second dimension groupBy stacked bar ReportChartSchema" → #27563 and #15734, both closed and about other gaps.

## Observed
`ReportChartSchema` (`packages/spec` `ui/report.zod.ts`) extends `ChartConfig` with one `xAxis` dimension and one `yAxis` measure, and `DatasetReportRenderer` queries exactly `chart.xAxis` × `chart.yAxis`. A report therefore cannot draw a bar per owner split by stage. The dashboard dataset path already pivots a second dimension into grouped series (`buildChartSeries` in `ui/packages/core`), so the renderer half can reuse it.

## Wanted
A declared series dimension key on `ReportChartSchema` (for example `series` or `groupBy`, a dimension name validated against the report's dataset). The report query is widened to it, and the renderer pivots through `buildChartSeries`. The ui half follows as a `domain:ui` card once the key ships.

Dedupe words: report chart series, second dimension, groupBy series, stacked bar report, ReportChartSchema.

Related: #27430 (row 4), #27563.
